name: mri-reface
label: MRI Reface
description: Runs mri_reface 0.3.5 (Schwarz et al., Mayo Clinic) to de-identify head scans by replacing the face with a population-average face. Accepts a NIfTI (.nii or .nii.gz) or a zipped single-series DICOM. Outputs the refaced NIfTI, the refaced DICOM (for DICOM input), and before/after face renders. mri_reface is free for non-commercial research use only.
author: NACC
cite: Schwarz CG, et al. Changing the face of neuroimaging research: Comparing a new MRI de-facing technique with popular alternatives. NeuroImage 2021. Schwarz CG, et al. Face recognition from research brain PET/MRI: an evaluation of re-identification risk and de-facing. NeuroImage 2023. doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2023.120199

input_file.description: Scan to reface: a NIfTI (.nii or .nii.gz) or a zip of DICOM files from a single series (.dicom.zip / .zip)

im_type.description: Image type passed to mri_reface -imType (strongly recommended by the author). Known MRI/CT values: T1, T2, FLAIR, T2st, ASL, CT. For PET types, see the run_mri_reface help. Leave empty to let mri_reface decide.

gzip_nifti.description: Compress the refaced NIfTI output to .nii.gz

save_transforms.description: Also save the registration files (affine .txt and warp .nii); off by default because they are large and rarely needed

extra_args.description: Additional mri_reface command-line arguments, passed through as-is

debug.description: Log extra detail (detected command, environment, all files produced)
